# G08-plan-exit-captured: Native Plan (set_mode plan, echoed as [MODE_UPDATE] plan): reads and the plan file under .gemini/tmp run without a question; exit_plan_mode asks as Gemini sends it (kind other, titled "Requesting plan approval for: <plan file>", no content, no always-option). The adapter reads the plan from that file (only under Gemini's own tmp folder), rejects (never approves: an approved exit could switch modes) and sends session/cancel; the prompt ends cancelled (no usage: a cancelled prompt carries none) and the pass succeeds with the plan.
# The live check that a live Gemini native Plan is captured: the recording has the plan file as a file frame before the exit request, and the replay captures the plan from it.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G08-plan-exit-captured --id G08 --slug plan-exit-captured --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G08-plan-exit-captured/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G08-plan-exit-captured/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G08-plan-exit-captured/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
